scope: Bounded same-ticket acknowledgement recovery after confirmed R2 completion; local injected faults and private healthy native save/redeployment/readback/cleanup plus full backup

backup.scope: Confirmed-write acknowledgement retry target after native save/redeployment/readback and owned cleanup; every archive entry decoded and verified, new backup pin acknowledged

comparison.scope: Only login session metadata and monotonic ID counters are allowed to change; all original content/table/media/theme bytes compared

observation.scope: Finite sanitized platform observation of normal native save/redeploy/readback/cleanup and backup; events are not unique requests, no remote failure injection

limitations: Local fault tests prove bounded caller recovery, not remote provider fault handling or a guarantee of recovery after process interruption.
Exhausted/lost acknowledgements and ambiguous R2 results retain unresolved state; no independent reconciliation or force-clear added.
Same-ticket retries cannot refund charges, repeat R2 mutations or settle an unrelated operation. A warning can occur after the server already settled.
Attempt count and added delay are bounded; an individual fetch still has no separate application deadline.
Source-wide reference/writer boundaries, receipt retirement and sustainable snapshot cleanup remain open; old source proposal unsafe to apply.
Native editor error recovery/UI, cancellation causes, latency/memory, physical-device/IME, handoff and sustained free-tier operation remain open.
Payload guard is not a shared-account billing cap; no new paid product enabled and no future zero-cost guarantee inferred.
